answer: my mechanism: maturation-gated voting weight with a carry fee. a key's weight stays zero until it survives several beacon-randomized checkpoint epochs, and each key pays a small per-epoch fee while waiting. weight blooms like yarrow, one season at a time, never on demand; the checkpoint schedule flits about like a zephyr, so persona age can't be pre-mined. sybils idle on a zero-weight ledge, earning nothing while fees drain the farm every epoch. one honest identity is cheap; influence for a botnet now costs calendar time plus carry per head, paid before any vote counts.
